title: UI/UX Lead
description:
UI/UX Designer - Lead
Plano, TX

60-65/hr on C2C/ 55/hr on W2

User Experience Designer:
(UXD) with 5–7 years shaping human-centered digital products. Design elegant, accessible experiences that simplify complex workflows and create measurable value across customer and employee journeys.
Work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and content strategists to drive end-to-end design across platforms. Some solutions may include AI-assisted features, focus remains on solving real user problems with clarity, usability, and empathy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver wireframes, prototypes, user flows, and high-fidelity mockups for responsive web and mobile platforms.
  • Solve interaction design challenges that balance usability, accessibility, and business objectives.
  • Ensure consistency with brand and design systems while exploring new patterns where necessary.
Research & Validation
  • Conduct or contribute to user research activities, including usability tests, interviews, and heuristic evaluations.
  • Translate insights into actionable design decisions, supporting continuous iteration and improvement.
  • Advocate for user needs and ethical design throughout the product lifecycle.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with product owners, engineers, and content teams to shape requirements and co-create user-centric solutions.
  • Participate in agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Clearly communicate design concepts and rationale to stakeholders of varying technical backgrounds.
Continuous Improvement
  • Qualifications
  • 5–7 years of experience in UX, product design, or interaction design.
  • Strong proficiency with design tools (Figma, Storybook, Adobe CC) and prototyping platforms.
  • Experience working in agile environments and collaborating across disciplines.
  • Familiar with responsive design, accessibility standards (WCAG), and usability heuristics.
  • Training and experience in strategy and design of AI-assisted experiences (personalization, smart search, automation).
  • Portfolio demonstrating design thinking, process, and impact across real-world applications.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Problem-solver, design with intention, keeping both business goals and user needs at the center.

  • Collaborative communicator: Thrive in teams, value feedback, and explain your work with clarity.

  • Outcome-focused: Think beyond features and care deeply about the real-world impact of your work.

title: SAP SD Analyst
description:
Hi,

We have an exciting contract opportunity with one of our clients.

If you're interested, please share your updated resume with me at santosh@dantatechnologies.net.

Title: SAP SD Analyst
Location: San Jose, CA - Onsite
Contract

Summary/Job Brief
The SAP SD Consultant is responsible for the design, implementation, and support of the SAP Sales and Distribution module. This role involves collaborating with business stakeholders to analyze and understand their business processes and requirements, and then translating those requirements into a functional and technical design within the SAP system. The consultant will be a key player in project life cycles, from initial blueprinting to go-live and post-implementation support.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Process Analysis & Requirements Gathering:
Work closely with business users and stakeholders to analyze complex sales and distribution business processes.
Identify and document business requirements, gaps, and issues.
Facilitate workshops to collect and validate requirements.

SAP SD Configuration & Implementation:
Design, configure, and customize the SAP SD module to meet business needs.
Configure key functionalities, including sales order processing, pricing, billing, shipping, and credit management.
Set up master data, such as customer and material master data.
Configure and manage pricing procedures, condition types, and access sequences.

Integration & Collaboration:
Ensure seamless integration of the SD module with other SAP modules, such as Materials Management (MM), Financial Accounting (FI), and Production Planning (PP).
Collaborate with other functional and technical teams (e.g., ABAP developers) to ensure a cohesive system and successful project delivery.

Testing & Troubleshooting:
Develop and execute test cases for unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and user acceptance testing (UAT).
Analyze and resolve software problems and system issues, acting as a liaison with the client for troubleshooting.
Perform system upgrades and enhancements to improve functionalities.

Support & Documentation:
Provide ongoing support to end-users for SAP SD-related queries and issues.
Create and maintain detailed documentation, including functional designs, configuration guides, and user manuals.
Conduct training sessions and workshops for end-users to ensure they are proficient in the SAP system.

Continuous Improvement:
Proactively identify and propose business process and system enhancements.
Stay up-to-date with the latest SAP advancements, best practices, and industry trends.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: Proven experience as an SAP SD Consultant, with hands-on experience in at least one full-cycle SAP implementation.

Technical Skills:
In-depth knowledge of the SAP SD module and its functionalities.
Proficiency in key SD components, including Sales Order Management, Pricing, Billing, Shipping & Logistics Execution, and Credit Management.
Strong understanding of integration points with other SAP modules (FI, MM).
Basic knowledge of ABAP debugging is a plus.

Professional Competencies:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders and document solutions.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Strong attention to detail and a meticulous approach to configuration and documentation.
Effective time management and the ability to handle multiple deliverables simultaneously.

title: SAP PLM Consultant
description:
Danta Technologies is currently hiring an SAP PLM Consultant. This position is located in Raleigh, NC, and requires On-site presence. I'd like you the go through the job description for your reference. If you are interested, please apply here.

Note: Independent candidates with valid U.S. work authorization are eligible for this position.

Job Title: SAP PLM Consultant
Location: Raleigh, NC - Onsite
Rate: $60/hr - $70/hr (W2 All-Inclusive on Danta Technologies Payroll)
Employment Type: W2 Contract
Duration: Contract 6+ months and possibility for extension - This duration is subject to changes based on the project's requirement and/or the client's sole discretion.
Client Industry: Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or Medical Device industries


Note: They are not looking for a general SAP functional consultant — they want someone who lives and breathes PLM in a complex, regulated enterprise environment.

Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP PLM Consultant with a strong background in SAP PLM PDM/PPM and S/4HANA implementations, specifically within Pharmaceutical, Life Sciences, or Medical Device industries.

The client wants someone who has:

  • Deep PLM expertise in SAP (not just surface-level knowledge)

  • Hands-on experience in regulated industries

  • Strong config, integration, and troubleshooting capabilities

  • Workflow and Fiori/UI5 know-how

  • Is comfortable collaborating with technical teams and stakeholders alike

Core Requirements (Non-Negotiable):

  1. Extensive SAP PLM Experience (9+ years)

    • Not just a general SAP consultant — someone who specializes in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), especially PDM and PPM modules.

  2. Industry-Specific Experience

    • Must have worked in pharmaceutical, life sciences, or medical device manufacturing — sectors that require tight compliance, traceability, and documentation control.

  3. Deep S/4HANA PLM Knowledge

    • Configuration of advanced PLM functionalities within S/4HANA, such as:

      • Engineering Change Management (ECM)

      • Document Management System (DMS)

      • EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) — especially recipe/specification management

      • BOM Versioning & Classifications

  4. Workflow & Fiori Integration

    • Able to build custom workflow configurations (approvals, rules, templates) using Fiori or Web UI.

  5. Data Synchronization and Integration

    • Recipe ↔ BOM syncing, ECM handling for recipes, and managing complex spec data (values, characteristics, phrases, etc.).

    • Experience with CAD, DMS, PPM, and folder/document integration.

  6. Strong Functional-Technical Collaboration

    • Write Functional Specs (FS) and coordinate Technical Specs (TS) with the ABAP team.

    • Work across cross-functional teams to implement solutions end-to-end.

  7. Problem Solver

    • Expected to own and resolve user issues, including integration bugs, data conversion issues, and workflow glitches.

Bonus/Preferred Skills:

  • Agile PLM Tools: Agile SDK, PX, WSX, Client, ACP

  • Third-party tools: Seal Systems, xECM/OpenText

  • Frontend apps: SAP UI5 (Fiori), NWBC

  • Data Migration Tools: SAP BODS

Soft Skills & Role Expectations:

  • Able to influence stakeholders and communicate at all organizational levels

  • Works independently without handholding

  • Can function as a lead or senior consultant in PLM areas
